# Bundled FFmpeg

LNscope ships this private, unmodified Windows x64 encoder. It is launched as a
separate process; it is not installed system-wide and is never resolved through PATH.
Keep this directory with the application when copying or publishing it.

- Version: 9.0.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev
- Publisher: Gyan Doshi, https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
- FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/
- Download: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip
- Matching FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/bf1b838f2a
- Source/build configuration: UPSTREAM-README.txt (as supplied by the publisher)
- License: GPL version 3; full text in LICENSE
- Downloaded archive SHA-256: fec81ae03971d9dd4be3ebe02e263bd2ec1d789483f931bdba5f5715e65da2e9
- ffmpeg.exe SHA-256: 72a489eccd008c2ec2c0a5856c5c75bc3d8bbfa90166c4566865c246445e6aa3

The downloaded archive was verified against the publisher's SHA-256 before
extracting the executable. No runtime download is performed. Builds and publishes
fail if the executable is absent. This notice, the license, and the upstream build
information are copied into every output and publish directory alongside the binary.
